parts.text: Which plan correctly separates the mixture?

options.text: Filter to remove sand, then evaporate the filtrate to recover salt.
Use only filtration once; that alone fully separates sand, salt, and water.
Evaporate first to dry everything, then filter the dry sand-and-salt powder to collect pure salt.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Tariq has a mixture of sand, salt, and water. He needs pure sand and pure salt as separate products.

part_answers.answer: Sand is insoluble so filtration removes it; salt stays dissolved and is recovered by evaporating the filtrate. One method alone cannot give both pure products.

teacher.key_rationale: Sand, salt, and water need a sequence: filter sand, then evaporate to get salt. Filtration alone leaves salt in water; evaporating first leaves a dry sand–salt mix that filtration cannot purify.
